title: Business English Conversation 12:  Postponing a Meeting
content: 1. a conference room: a room where workers can meet and work together - Our company has many conference rooms that employees can use. - We can use this conference room. 2. to reschedule a meeting: to change the time or date of a meeting - Can we reschedule our meeting for 4 pm today instead of 3 pm? - She rescheduled our meeting again. That is the third time this week.
